card.name: Linking words before opioid drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, of, to, onto and including that come right before a specific opioid drug name (codeine, buprenorphine, hydrocodone). Seen in opioid label text about dosing, initiation and respiratory depression.

modes.label: With/of before opioid name
modes.description: A linking word right after treatment or dosage terms, just before the opioid is named.
modes.example: Titrate the dosage<< of>> Hydrocodone Bitartrate and

modes.label: Including or to before opioid
modes.description: A listing or conversion word that introduces a named opioid.
modes.example: has been reported with the use of opioids,<< including>> codeine, one of the active ingredients

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward naming a specific drug next, though the promoted tokens look unrelated (electrolysis, electrode terms).
card.plain: It fires on little words like 'with' or 'of' just before an opioid's name is written.
